other_conditions: Only one applicant is allowed per family.
Applicants must have prior beekeeping training from KVIC, NABARD, KVK, or other approved training centres.
Applicants must be farmers engaged in beekeeping on their own land or on registered lease land.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 80% subsidy on beekeeping inputs (Rs 350 per box, up to 4 boxes per beneficiary) along with training support and financial assistance for beekeepers.
